purpose: Validate independent qNEHVI acquisition and posterior-assisted orchestration, typed exploitation blocking, support/fallback behavior, and common real evaluation without claiming architecture, calibration, or algorithm-performance acceptance.

strategy_owns: persistent posterior sampler and chunked current-cost projection
implementation_boundary.backend_owns: BoTorch qLogNoisyExpectedHypervolumeImprovement hypervolume, partitioning, and log-improvement numerics

structural_acceptance.invalid_projection_policy: reject the complete affected Monte Carlo draw
structural_acceptance.backend_failure_policy: full real-search plus common real evaluation
structural_acceptance.applicability_exploitation_policy: exclude below a separately sealed calibrated threshold
structural_acceptance.applicability_exploration_policy: retain explicit real exploration with auditable low/boundary counts

real_canary.posterior_capability: typed deliberate performance-not-accepted / uncalibrated / non-transferable blocker
real_canary.simulator_process_policy: one foreground yadof process; no duplicate

activation_preconditions: one architecture passes its independent performance gate
posterior calibration on independent designs passes and is transferable to the exact strategy state
applicability probability capability, threshold, policy version, boundary rule, and exploration quota are sealed before test access
strategy identity binds every control and objective name
082612 same-budget performance plan snapshots the accepted capability identities
post_validation_rule: Any failing mechanism check may repair implementation and requires a new plan revision before rerun; no result may change the frozen v5/v8 evidence or activate exploitation.
